builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Ornn: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A scaling frontline initiator who creates terrain, knocks enemies into it and consumes Brittle through attacks or immobilization. Measure Brittle consumption and forge upgrade states separately. Full build does not imply every chosen item is upgraded; AP experiments need the current compatible ratios verified. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
builds.summary: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Ornn: Measure Brittle consumption and forge upgrade states separately. Full build does not imply every chosen item is upgraded; AP experiments need the current compatible ratios verified.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Ornn's stated kit question: Measure Brittle consumption and forge upgrade states separately. Full build does not imply every chosen item is upgraded; AP experiments need the current compatible ratios verified.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.

kitEvidence.formula:
Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing [12 / 13 / 14 / 15 / 16]% max Health magic damage over [0.75] seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for [3] seconds.

Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(0.09 → 0.17; raw flags preserved)] max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage.

Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by [40 / 50 / 60]% for [3] seconds.

Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for [1] second and subsequent champions for [(1) × (0.5)] seconds. The elemental also deals [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and reapplies Brittle.

Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage and Slowing by [40]% for [2] seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for [4] seconds.

Ornn charges, dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.4) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.4) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for [1.25] seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge.

Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.

builds.name: Brittle proximity amplifier
builds.summary: Protect close access to amplify Brittle magic packets without claiming AP scales them.
builds.goal: Protect close access to amplify Brittle magic packets without claiming AP scales them.
builds.hypothesis: W deals target-max-health magic damage and Brittle triggers an additional level-scaled max-health magic packet on immobilization or an attack knockback. Abyssal rewards that close range; Iceborn asks for an attack after W and Visage/Unending Despair provide conditional recovery. Q pillar sets an E collision.
testPlan: Required state: Land final W flame, then consume Brittle within three seconds while aura is in range.
Separate W flames, Brittle proc and item packets with and without nearby Abyssal.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Spacing mistakes lose the Brittle trigger and sacrifice ordinary tank utility.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP on R does not imply W/Brittle have AP ratios.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Iceborn Gauntlet, Abyssal Mask, Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
